answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in planning and decision making tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on using LLMs for planning tasks where the model generates code and actions to solve complex, long-horizon decision-making problems in interactive environments.

answer_2.quote: We show that REPL-Plan achieves strong performance in challenging text-based sequential decision making environments ALF-World and Web-Shop.
